title: Dolphins GM Jon-Eric Sullivan: Every team needing a QB is talking about Malik Willis

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dolphins GM Jon-Eric Sullivan: Every team needing a QB is talking about Malik Willis
sources.description: New Dolphins General Manager Jon-Eric Sullivan previously worked in Green Bay, as did new Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley, which means both of them got an up-close look at quarterback Malik Willis.
